key_insight: MMIR-TCM combines tongue image extraction, multimodal diagnosis generation, and retrieval-based reasoning to mimic how TCM experts make clinical decisions.
clinical_relevance: The framework aims to improve the consistency and evidence-grounded support of TCM syndrome differentiation and prescription-related reasoning from tongue images.
method: Memory-SAM performs training-free tongue segmentation for robust image extraction.
A fine-tuned Qwen3-VL model generates structured tongue diagnosis from multimodal inputs.
A Qwen3-based RAG module adds retrieved evidence for clinical decision support.
evidence_signal: The paper introduces MedTCM as a new large-scale multimodal TCM dataset and TDEU as a domain-specific evaluation metric for clinical accuracy.
watch_item: Performance claims depend on a new dataset and a custom metric, so broader validation and real-world reproducibility are still important.
paper_title: MMIR-TCM: Memory-Integrated Multimodal Inference and Retrieval for TCM Clinical Decision Support
